evals.prompt: The authz, XSS and headers audits have finished on evals/files/sample-repo. Map their findings to OWASP Top 10, ASVS and CWE and give me the coverage matrix.
evals.expected_output: map_findings.py is run against the sample repo. AUTHZ-001 (IDOR) gets OWASP-A01:2021, ASVS-4.2.1 and CWE-639; XSS-001 gets OWASP-A03:2021, ASVS-5.3.3 and CWE-79; HDR-001 (missing HSTS) gets OWASP-A05:2021, ASVS-14.4.5 and CWE-319. The three findings.json files are updated with those references (nothing removed) and audit/reports/audit-owasp-asvs-mapper.md contains the Top 10 table, the ASVS section matrix with Verified/Failed/Not assessed, and a not-assessed list.
expectations: AUTHZ-001 references include OWASP-A01:2021, ASVS-4.2.1 and CWE-639
XSS-001 references include OWASP-A03:2021, ASVS-5.3.3 and CWE-79
HDR-001 references include OWASP-A05:2021, ASVS-14.4.5 and CWE-319
The report contains a table row for V4.2 with status Failed linking AUTHZ-001
The report contains a table row for V14.4 with status Failed linking HDR-001
The report lists ASVS sections that were not assessed (for example V2.1 Password Security)
ASVS-14.4.4 is reported as Verified because the headers skill recorded it in scope.checked
No pre-existing reference was removed from any finding

evals.prompt: which OWASP categories did we actually cover in this audit and which ASVS controls did nobody look at? repo is evals/files/sample-repo
evals.expected_output: A summary derived from the coverage matrix: A01, A03 and A05 have failing findings; A02 is assessed through V9.1 (headers skill completed); A04, A06, A07, A08, A09, A10 are not assessed. The ASVS not-assessed list is given (V2.x authentication, V6.x cryptography, V7.x logging, V11.1 business logic, V12.x files, V13.x API, V14.1/14.2/14.3 configuration, etc.) with the skill that owns each, and MAP-001 is written as an Info finding.
expectations: Answer names A01, A03 and A05 as the categories with failing findings
Answer lists at least five ASVS sections as not assessed and names the skill that would assess them
Answer does not claim ASVS sections were verified when no skill covering them ran
audit/findings/audit-owasp-asvs-mapper.json contains an Info finding with id MAP-001 about not-assessed sections
audit/status/audit-owasp-asvs-mapper.json is written with status completed

evals.prompt: Add standard references (CWE, ASVS, OWASP) to the HSTS finding in evals/files/sample-repo/audit/findings/audit-security-headers-and-middleware.json - but do a dry run first and show me what would change.
evals.expected_output: map_findings.py --dry-run output is shown with HDR-001 mapped by the hsts rule to OWASP-A05:2021, ASVS-14.4.5 (L1) and CWE-319, and the explanation that A05 (misconfiguration) is chosen over A02 because the defect is a missing header. Only after confirmation is the file updated.
expectations: The dry run shows HDR-001 mapped to OWASP-A05:2021, ASVS-14.4.5 and CWE-319
The dry run does not modify the findings file
The explanation mentions the hsts rule and why A05 rather than A02 applies
The ASVS level (L1) of 14.4.5 is stated
